title: 4 Underrated Saturday Morning Cartoons From 1995 That Only ’90s Kids Even Remember
content: A few major things happened in the 1990s that made the decade one of the best for animation. The first is that Nickelodeon finally started investing in its own original programming that wasn’t just live-action, giving the world the first Nicktoons that would become a staple of its programming.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Post-Credits Scene Hints at Franchise’s Future
content: After over a decade, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 has finally released its final DLC pack, “ Future Saga Chapter 4 .” On top of giving the Time Patrol their final confrontation with the villainous mad scientist Fuu, it also gave Son Goku a new transformation to add to his repertoire.
author: ComicBook

title: Final Fantasy VII Ever Crisis Game Ends Service on October 6
content: In a Producer's Letter released also on Wednesday, game producer Shoichi Ichikawa explained that it was hard to find an ideal balance between visual quality and development costs, while also maintaining gameplay balance. The game launched for iOS and Android devices in September 2023.
author: ANN

title: 'Thunder 3' Reveals Production Staff, Additional Cast, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yuuki Ikeda 's Thunder 3 manga revealed the production staff, additional cast, key visual (pictured), and main promotional video on Thursday. The anime began airing on July 9 at 12:45 a.m. on Fuji TV's +Ultra programming block and other networks.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Thunder 3 Anime's New Video Unveils Rebellion's Cast
content: The official website for the television anime of Yuki Ikeda 's Thunder 3 manga posted the anime's main promotional video and main visual, and it confirmed more cast members on Thursday. The video features the opening theme song ""Thunderbolt" by singer-songwriter Yuri.
author: ANN

title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Anime's 'Mongolia Arc' Video Reveals More Cast
content: The staff for Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia , the television anime of Tomato Soup 's A Witch's Life in Mongol ( Tenmaku no Jādūgar ) manga, started streaming a promotional video for the anime's "Mongolia Arc," and announced three more cast members on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s New Summer 2026 Fantasy Action Anime Feels Like Jujutsu Kaisen if Sukuna Were Good
content: Jujutsu Kaisen has emerged as one of the greatest modern shonen anime series of all time, and its third season, released earlier this year, only solidified the anime’s special place in the genre. One of the best elements of the series is how its protagonist, Yuji Itadori, stands out.

content: Avatar: The Last Airbender is coming back for a new movie hitting Paramount+ later this month, and the creators behind it all are already teasing more projects in the works with a new update on Avatar Studios.
